Riley: Kicking off Bridge beta enrollment ops. Launch next Wed. Need final CSV, invite cadence, two feedback touchpoints, and renewal-risk routing. Target: 3 waves, ~110 seats.

Tarek: Which CSV fields do you need? email,company,owner,seat_count,timezone,renewal_bucket,flags?

Riley: Yes + contact_pref and eu_consent_required. Also add 'ae_name' for personalized templates.

June: I'll prepare the file and upload to drive. Preferred invite plan: VIP AE template for pilot_priority=true, standard template otherwise.

Marta: For feedback, propose pre-survey (use-case), day 4 micro-NPS in-app, and week 3 longer checklist + interview ask. EU accounts get email fallback until consent.

InviteBot: Scheduled job "bridge-invite-batch" 2026-05-12T15:00Z. Throttle 25/hr/region.

Tarek: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood.co/bridge/enroll_final.csv (111 rows). I flagged 20 VIPs and 12 EU-consent rows.

June: Invite sequencing: send VIPs first in small batches so AEs can prep; then standard cohorts. If invite bounce, mark for manual AE workflow.

Marta: Owners: @June = CSV + intake, @Marta = surveys + interviews, @Tarek = invite plumbing & flags, @Riley = program lead.

Tarek: Dev notes: gate on flag bridge_beta=true; instrumentation endpoints for first_successful_call and first_vector_store_create will be added to CS dashboard.

Riley: Renewal routing: any renewal_30 + low pre_survey_intent => route to AE for immediate outreach. Add 'renewal_high_touch' tag on ingest.

June: Links: onboarding assets folder https://drive.redwood.co/bridge/assets, runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.co/bridge/invite-playbook.md

Marta: I'll post survey copy tomorrow EOD. Incentives: small gift for interviewees, tracked in sheet.

InviteBot: Action created: "bridge-invite-warmup" 2026-05-11T16:00Z.

Riley: Thanks team. Final go/no-go check tomorrow 09:30 PT. Ping me with blockers. :rocket:
